caption:
MINI CHOCOLATE CHEESECAKE -
NO BAKE, EGGLESS
READY IN 2 HOURS :) 

Ingredients: 
Crust: 
- 3 mini oreo packets - 46 grams each
- 25 - 30 grams butter, melted

Cheesecake Mix: 
- 140 grams chocolate, anything between 55 - 70 % works here, melted and cooled slightly
- 230 grams cream cheese, softened at room tempreture
- 50 grams caster sugar
- 10 grams brown sugar
- 1/2 tbsp cocoa powder
- 1/2 tsp vanilla
- 100 ml heavy cream

Ganache topping:
100 gm chocolate
100 ml cream 
Optional: additional 30 grams of  whipped cream gives a light and airy ganache for the topping 

Method:
Mentioned in the video :)

This recipe makes 10 cups in a standard cupcake pan
